mods.name: secret-filename-guard
mods.description: Asks before a Bash command touches a secret-looking file (.env, private keys, credentials).

mods.name: secret-guard
mods.description: Asks before a live API key, token or private key is written, edited or run.

mods.name: env-exfil-guard
mods.description: Asks before a command prints your environment, echoes a secret variable or sends local data to a remote host.

mods.name: infra-guard
mods.description: Asks before terraform destroy, kubectl delete, force-push, DROP TABLE or rm -rf.

mods.name: secret-commit-guard
mods.description: Asks before a git commit that would record a credential or a secret-named file.

mods.name: protect-main
mods.description: Asks before a commit, push or merge while you are on main or master.

mods.name: gitignore-check
mods.description: Asks before git add or commit when secret-looking files are not ignored or are already tracked.

mods.name: secret-output-guard
mods.description: Tells Claude not to repeat a credential that showed up in command or file output, and names the source to rotate.

mods.name: guard-pack
mods.description: Every Baselane guard in one mod.
